4lf__ie: Gideon Lfie came from Stoneyford, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

Gideon Lfie went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Karel "Mole" Kieran was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@kim_jong_un_kieran) Gideon Lfie joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F9. Gideon Lfie has learned to walk bent double.

Gideon Lfie raised his head for a heartbeat too long at Q-F9. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Henrik Houghton of the Hegemony (@patrick.houghton.5602). Gideon Lfie swept the enemy parapet at Q-F9 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Cyril Catatfire was grazed. After the loss of Grey Mill, Gideon Lfie helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Gideon Lfie was hit through the chest at Q-F9. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Henrik Houghton of the Hegemony (@patrick.houghton.5602). Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Gideon Lfie was admitted to the hospital dugout and finally let go of his rifle. Gideon Lfie is out of the worst of it. He sleeps most of the day, and the surgeon lets him.
Gideon Lfie spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
Gideon Lfie asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
The House of Lfie sent Konrad Lfie after Gideon Lfie. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Nobody else in Q-F9 wanted the stripes. Konrad Lfie said yes. Lance Corporal.
Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Konrad Lfie only heard boots on the duckboards at Q-F9, then nothing but pain. Raider: Florian Jimjamjom of the Hegemony (@jimjamjom_).
alice.is.ali: Nobody saw Rafael "Shadow" Ali arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in P-F14, and a quiet rifleman under it.

A bullet found Rafael "Shadow" Ali at P-F14, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Jonas Art of the Concord (@c_crash_trash_art). Rafael "Shadow" Ali was hit at P-F14 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Jonas Art of the Concord (@c_crash_trash_art).

Another member of the House of Ali reached the line: Karel Ali. He asked where Rafael "Shadow" Ali had slept, then chose a different corner. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Karel Ali helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Karel Ali spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Ali. Karel Ali read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Karel Ali said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Karel Ali began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
Karel Ali and Otto "Shadow" Ghost argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Karel Ali's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
bigpipguy: Marek Bigpipguy took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
A replacement turned out to be from Varenne too. Marek Bigpipguy and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.

Marek Bigpipguy is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed. The transfer made Marek Bigpipguy a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Marek Bigpipguy added a leak above the man's head in pencil. A letter from home reached Marek Bigpipguy before dusk. Marek Bigpipguy read it twice and slept a little easier.
Marek Bigpipguy spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.

Marek Bigpipguy jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Roland Zle. The Concord medics will be busy. (@yee.zle) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Marek Bigpipguy snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Marek Bigpipguy free. Marek Bigpipguy walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Marek Bigpipguy came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. The clerk counted the names twice. Marek Bigpipguy is number 421 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill has been won. Marek Bigpipguy listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Marek Bigpipguy drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
Marek Bigpipguy delivered an urgent message and waited while the officer searched every pocket for a pencil to sign for it.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit Marek Bigpipguy in the neck at S-S12. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Marek Bigpipguy has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance. The worst has passed for Marek Bigpipguy. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.
Marek Bigpipguy drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.

The medics called Marek Bigpipguy 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Marek Bigpipguy is back on the line. The letter for Marek Bigpipguy ended with 'come home soon'. Marek Bigpipguy read the last line more than the rest. The new duty roster listed Marek Bigpipguy as a stretcher bearer. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
ekwilks: Day 6. The corporal put Arno Ekwilks beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag saw Arno Ekwilks freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Mud said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. A letter from home reached Arno Ekwilks before dusk. Arno Ekwilks read it twice and slept a little easier.

A muddy dog crawled into S-S11 through the wire. Arno Ekwilks gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Mercy. A letter from home reached Arno Ekwilks before dusk. Arno Ekwilks read it twice and slept a little easier.

Mercy has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Arno Ekwilks is very proud. Mercy is mainly proud of the biscuits. A letter from home reached Arno Ekwilks before dusk. Arno Ekwilks read it twice and slept a little easier.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Arno Ekwilks stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Arno Ekwilks before dusk. Arno Ekwilks read it twice and slept a little easier.

Arno Ekwilks remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Arno Ekwilks answered to number 450. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Arno Ekwilks wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Arno Ekwilks and Hugo "Bones" Squared carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident. A letter from home reached Arno Ekwilks before dusk. Arno Ekwilks read it twice and slept a little easier.
Arno Ekwilks caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.

Arno Ekwilks taught Emil Szko three words in the language of home. Emil uses all three at the wrong moment, every day. A letter from home reached Arno Ekwilks before dusk. Arno Ekwilks read it twice and slept a little easier.

Arno Ekwilks spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath Grey Mill someone else was digging too. A letter from home reached Arno Ekwilks before dusk. Arno Ekwilks read it twice and slept a little easier.
Arno Ekwilks hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint.
forgacserik: Day 10: Valentin Forgacserik reached T-F9 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Valentin Forgacserik polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Valentin Forgacserik could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
The shelling stopped while Valentin Forgacserik was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Valentin Forgacserik ate two helpings anyway.
Valentin Forgacserik fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Quentin Charlesdiabl, now badly wounded.
Valentin Forgacserik sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.

A bullet hit Valentin Forgacserik in the neck at T-F9. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Emil "Doc" Weir of the Concord (@walkem.down.weir). Valentin Forgacserik was killed outright at T-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Emil "Doc" Weir of the Concord (@walkem.down.weir).
The papers say Rafael Forgacserik. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Valentin Forgacserik's eyes. Nobody in T-F9 argues.
hanka_b97: The new rifleman gave his name as Bastian "Owl" Hanka. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Bastian "Owl" Hanka was number 2. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
A flare lit the Ossuary Wood like noon. Bastian "Owl" Hanka counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Bastian "Owl" Hanka started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."

The relief reached S-F11 without Bastian "Owl" Hanka. His name was added to a list the corporal kept separate from the dead. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Bastian "Owl" Hanka stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Nobody at S-F11 has seen Bastian "Owl" Hanka since the last patrol. His bunk is still made.

Bastian "Owl" Hanka is still missing. The sergeant keeps his name on the roll and calls it out every morning anyway. At dusk Bastian "Owl" Hanka walked back into S-F11, covered in mud, and asked for a place on the wiring party. The sergeant crossed the name off the missing list.

Wiring party. Bastian "Owl" Hanka held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F11, and everyone came back. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at S-F11 changed before the cheering ended. Bastian "Owl" Hanka shouldered another load.
Bastian "Owl" Hanka's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point."
Bastian "Owl" Hanka washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
Bastian "Owl" Hanka read his diary from the start tonight and laughed at how frightened he was back then. Then he stopped laughing and wrote: "Still here."

Bastian "Owl" Hanka felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F11. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Oskar Pearson of the Concord (@_william.pearson_).

Bastian "Owl" Hanka rejoined the squad at S-F11. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Bastian "Owl" Hanka folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A note came over the wire at Verdel Ridge, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Hegemony. Signed, Karel "Ash" Johannmigano.' Bastian "Owl" Hanka sang louder. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Bastian "Owl" Hanka could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Bastian "Owl" Hanka was hit through the chest at S-F11. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Karel Stefan of the Concord (@mar.stefan16). Bastian "Owl" Hanka was killed at S-F11 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Karel Stefan of the Concord (@mar.stefan16).
Benedikt "Crow" Hanka had heard about Bastian "Owl" Hanka's courage. At S-F11, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Benedikt "Crow" Hanka spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Benedikt "Crow" Hanka fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.

Benedikt "Crow" Hanka had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Quentin Katdog, grazed. Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Roland Potato stood up to sing louder, and Benedikt "Crow" Hanka fired. Roland Potato was badly wounded. The singing stopped.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-F11. Benedikt "Crow" Hanka fired at the last man to run. Karel Stefan was gravely wounded.
jakegriffal: Dietrich Jakegriffal walked into P-F13 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In P-F13, Dietrich Jakegriffal listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Dietrich Jakegriffal tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Oakmere. Every version sounded like the ration bell. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Dietrich Jakegriffal watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Promoted to Lance Corporal, Dietrich Jakegriffal had to settle an argument he had been happily taking part in five minutes earlier.
Dietrich Jakegriffal made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Casimir Yelloowman wrote a letter for Dietrich Jakegriffal's mother, because Dietrich could not find the words. Dietrich signed it.
On a quiet night Dietrich Jakegriffal (Concord) and Teodor "Hollow" Aim (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
Dietrich Jakegriffal cut Arno Collinjsamps's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
liamlove447: Wendel Liamlove was a farmhand in Rosenau until the posters went up. He came to T-F21 with a stub of a pencil, and within a day the whole squad knew that he never takes off his scarf.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Wendel Liamlove stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Wendel Liamlove. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Wendel Liamlove watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Wendel Liamlove had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
The colonel asked who held the line at Saint-Ash crossroads last night. Every finger pointed at Wendel Liamlove. Lance Corporal.
Wendel Liamlove read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
Wendel Liamlove put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
A newspaper reached Wendel Liamlove with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
maccerny808: Nobody saw Roland Maccerny arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F4, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Roland Maccerny wrote a letter for Lucien "Shadow" Jro's mother, because Shadow could not find the words. Shadow signed it.

Roland Maccerny found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Roland Maccerny looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A parcel from home held a comb. Roland Maccerny has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
Roland Maccerny saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.

Roland Maccerny raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F4. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Albin Travismac of the Hegemony (@travismac78). Roland Maccerny fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-F4. Silas Hansen was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Roland Maccerny rejoined the squad at S-F4. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Roland Maccerny kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Roland Maccerny checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more. Roland Maccerny got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 263. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-F4, Roland Maccerny listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Roland Maccerny borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
A clear shot from S-F4. Roland Maccerny grazed Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer and slid back down below the parapet.
A flare caught Roland Maccerny halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
At S-F4 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Roland Maccerny won the bet. Ivo Enriquez was grazed.
Roland Maccerny saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-F4 and fired once. Jakub Relations was gravely wounded.
markusapina: On the way to R-C6, Lucien Markusapina tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Lucien Markusapina shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Lucien Markusapina owes Emil "Button" Mugginsthede so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full. Lucien Markusapina got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 647. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill has been won. Lucien Markusapina listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Lucien Markusapina sent a pigeon back to headquarters. The pigeon came back two hours later. Lucien Markusapina took it personally.
Lucien Markusapina taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks.
Tobias Avtomat (Concord) and Lucien Markusapina (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Blackwater Canal. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Lucien Markusapina's ear at R-C6 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Yann Kwintenlulay of the Concord (@kwintenlulay_).

Machine-gun fire swept R-C6. Lucien Markusapina took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Wendel "Bones" Schildbroete of the Concord (@schildbroete). The beds were full. Lucien Markusapina waits on a stretcher in the dark with a medic's promise and a dry mouth.
mng.ngaihte: The quartermaster asked Benedikt Ngaihte to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

A clear shot from R-F7. Benedikt Ngaihte grazed Jonas Steini and slid back down below the parapet. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Benedikt Ngaihte read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Benedikt Ngaihte kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.

Benedikt Ngaihte opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. A letter from home found Benedikt Ngaihte before the night shift. Benedikt Ngaihte folded it small and kept it close.

The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Benedikt Ngaihte offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once. A letter from home found Benedikt Ngaihte before the night shift. Benedikt Ngaihte folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Benedikt Ngaihte did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Benedikt Ngaihte fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Edmund Crack, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home found Benedikt Ngaihte before the night shift. Benedikt Ngaihte folded it small and kept it close.
A parcel came for Benedikt Ngaihte that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

The parcel's address was smudged. Benedikt Ngaihte took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry. A letter from home found Benedikt Ngaihte before the night shift. Benedikt Ngaihte folded it small and kept it close.
Benedikt Ngaihte caught a supply driver heading for one of the units and handed the parcel over with a note asking for word when it arrived.

Benedikt Ngaihte saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-F7 and fired once. Teodor "Button" Magtyu was grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Benedikt Ngaihte helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Benedikt Ngaihte swept the enemy parapet at R-F7 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Jonas Inyoursk was badly wounded. Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Leopold Rockytheauti stood up to sing louder, and Benedikt Ngaihte fired. Leopold Rockytheauti was badly wounded. The singing stopped. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Benedikt Ngaihte answered to number 162. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Benedikt Ngaihte during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Benedikt Ngaihte was faster. Matthias World was grazed.

Benedikt Ngaihte fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr was grazed. A letter from home found Benedikt Ngaihte before the night shift. Benedikt Ngaihte folded it small and kept it close.

A card reached Benedikt Ngaihte: the parcel had found its owner. The message said thank you, and that two knitted scarves had come just in time. A letter from home found Benedikt Ngaihte before the night shift. Benedikt Ngaihte folded it small and kept it close.
Dawn watch. Benedikt Ngaihte put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Edmund Crack, grazed.

The Concord raiders came over at R-F7 in the middle of the night. Benedikt Ngaihte met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Severin "Owl" Javimty of the Concord (@javimty97).
The papers connected Hugo "Tin" Ngaihte to Benedikt Ngaihte. The men took longer to learn Hugo "Tin" Ngaihte's own habits, but they made the effort.
thedanlyfe: "You're late," said the corporal when Gustav Thedanlyfe arrived on Day 13. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Gustav Thedanlyfe. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.

The men at V-F16 heard Gustav Thedanlyfe call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Leopold "Ghost" Warm of the Concord (@jarm_the_warm). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Gustav Thedanlyfe fell at V-F16 and never moved again. Shot by Leopold "Ghost" Warm of the Concord (@jarm_the_warm).
Anselm Thedanlyfe asked about Gustav Thedanlyfe on arriving at V-F16. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Anselm Thedanlyfe fired at the enemy dawn watch from V-F16. Teodor Robboyd was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
